List, test and probe configured accounts

## Usage

```text
chainmail accounts
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```

## Commands

- [chainmail accounts list](./chainmail-accounts-list.md): List accounts and whether they can log in
- [chainmail accounts probe](./chainmail-accounts-probe.md): Measure how many IMAP connections accounts allow, and size their pools from it
- [chainmail accounts test](./chainmail-accounts-test.md): Log in to an account's IMAP and SMTP servers
